sources.entry: Yamtrack ⚠ - Media tracker for movies, tv shows, anime, manga, video games and books. (Demo) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Yamtrack is a self-hosted media tracker for movies, TV shows, anime, manga, video games, books, comics, and board games.
summary.what_it_does: Yamtrack lets you log and track media across movies, TV shows, anime, manga, games, books, comics, and board games. You can track individual seasons and episodes, and save scores, status, progress, repeats, dates, and notes. It keeps a history of actions on each item and supports custom entries for media the supported APIs cannot find. Users can create personal lists, share them with collaborators, and view upcoming releases in a calendar that can be subscribed to via an iCalendar (.ics) URL. It supports multiple user accounts, OIDC and social login via django-allauth, notifications via Apprise, integration with Jellyfin, Plex and Emby, imports from Trakt, Simkl, MyAnimeList, AniList and Kitsu, and CSV export and import.
use_cases: track movies and tv shows watched
keep a manga, anime, or book reading log
share media lists with family or friends
import watch history from Trakt or MyAnimeList
how_to_run: Download the default docker-compose.yml from the repository
Update the environment values in the file
notable: Tracks seasons and individual episodes for TV shows
Syncs watch activity from Jellyfin, Plex and Emby
Imports from Trakt, Simkl, MyAnimeList, AniList and Kitsu with periodic automatic imports
Multi-user accounts with shared collaborative lists
caveats: Default Docker setup uses SQLite; PostgreSQL and reverse proxy setup are covered in separate documentation
Development setup is described only in separate documentation, not in the README
Listed in awesome-selfhosted with a warning marker (⚠), reason not stated in the README
